svg.title: FinGuard poster
svg.desc: FinGuard, HackNC 2026: an AI money agent that has to show its evidence before it acts. Three principles, the request flow, measured results, live integrations, and the repository link.
svg.text: An AI money agent that has to
show its evidence before it acts.
Agents that can pay bills also read scam texts and fake invoices, and those
words can steer where the money goes.
Each payee, account and amount has to
come from your own words or your bank's
records. A value that appears only in a
forwarded text or an invoice is blocked.
A 4-digit code is bound to a SHA-256 hash
of the tool and its exact arguments. It expires
in 2 minutes and approves nothing else.
verify stops at #43, the first altered event
Every step is an event whose hash covers the
one before it, so an edited or deleted event
shows up as a break in the chain.
You type in the app or text
SkillGate eval cases; both misses are
Money settlement is simulated on a ledger over live Nessie reads. No real money moves.
